name: AI Financial Corporation
summary: AI Financial Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, provides payment processing, quantum security, tokenization, and AI-native commerce worldwide. Its products include ALT5 Prime, an institutional market access and liquidity; ALT5 Pay, an infrastructure for crypto and global payment processing; Stradacarte, connecting digital balances to real world payment experience for consumesr and enterprises; and agentic commerce, a software-driven systems continue to advance, automated interactions among services are expected to grow, driving the need for payment infrastructure that enables programmable and system-led transactions. The company was formerly known as ALT5 Sigma Corporation and changed its name to AI Financial Corporation in April 2026. AI Financial Corporation was founded in 1976 and is based in Las Vegas, Nevada.
